content:
**History view: git/tag facts, merged events, Reviews-mode link (#882 PR 4)**

Added the History governance sub-view (R882-5), PR 4 of 5 in the #882
chain. status/history.mjs's gatherHistoryFacts reads git log (commit sha,
date, subject, a trailing (#N) citation — never asserted as a PR number,
since this repo's own log mixes squash suffixes and hand-written issue
citations with no textual signal telling them apart) and git tags through the same
injected _run seam release-debt.mjs already uses; either read failing is
the whole section's own {ok:false, reason}. snapshot.mjs wires history in
additively, beside the nine existing sections. lib/history-model.mjs's
buildHistoryModel merges three event kinds newest-first through
governance-model.mjs's shared row() helper: a merge event per commit
(sourced to the forge URL, through lib/forge-url.mjs's prUrl, when the
served project and a cited reference are both known, to git otherwise —
never a fabricated link from one alone, and never asserting the citation
is a PR), a
release event per tag, and an adr-amended event per dated ADR amendment.
Review verdicts are deliberately excluded: no field anywhere in the data
carries a review round's timestamp (prReviews returns {state, author,
body} only), so app.js's renderHistory links to the existing Reviews mode
instead of rendering a second, undated projection of the same rounds.
No score or ranking anywhere in this view (issue #882's own guard) — a
plain event count sits beside the list it counts.

CORRECTION (fresh-context review of PR 4, blocker): an earlier version of
this record claimed lib/forge-url.mjs "does not exist anywhere in this
codebase, verified by full-repo search." That was true only of PR 4's own
stale cut point, before the forward-merge from the tracker — it shipped
on the tracker in PR 1 (#1037), and PR 3 already imports it there. After
merging the tracker forward, history-model.mjs imports prUrl from
lib/forge-url.mjs directly (one definition, not a second hand-built
https://github.com/... template) and buildHistoryModel's citedRef field
(renamed from an earlier prNumber, per the same review's blocker on
asserting "PR") sources its merge event through that shared builder.
state.meta?.project is real (server.mjs's buildMeta() -> sent on the
'sync' SSE frame -> merged into state.meta by frames.mjs's applyFrame).
buildHistoryModel's signature is {history, adrs, project} (project
optional, defaulting to null) because provenance.mjs's sourceStamp
requires a full https://.../pull/N URL to render the [forge: #N] label
spec.md's own scenario demands — a bare citedRef alone cannot produce
that label. governance-model.mjs's stale History placeholder text was
left untouched, following PR 2/PR 3's own established precedent for that
same table.

Counted diff 222 before the forward-merge (plan estimate ~380, budget 1000); full suite 5899 pass / 0 fail before the merge (baseline after PR 3's local pre-squash head: 5879 pass / 0 fail). See the fresh-context-review-fixes record for the numbers after the tracker merge and the blocker/warning fixes.
